text: Mir geht es psychisch deutlich besser als vor der Erfahrung. Ich bin ausgeglichener, schlafe besser und habe mehr Freude an meiner Arbeit und an meinen Hobbys. Ich fühle mich insgesamt zufriedener mit meinem Leben und dankbarer für das, was ich habe. Auch meine Kollegen sagen, dass ich viel entspannter wirke.
I'm happier, less anxious and I don't overthink everything like before. I enjoy my free time without guilt.

I understand where my anxiety and hypervigilance come from now, and that has helped me a lot. I used to think I was just a nervous person, but now I see it as a reaction to growing up in an unsafe home. That understanding has made me much more compassionate towards myself. My anxiety is still there, but it's less intense, and I have more good days. I've also felt more love for myself, which is new for me. The trauma therapy I started afterwards has been really helpful, and I think the experience was what made me ready for it.
Auch hier kann ich keinen eindeutigen Effekt feststellen.
Since then I take more chances and I'm curious about unfamiliar ideas. Failure scares me much less, and that has made me happier and surer of myself.
It's ok, a bit better

Ich habe weniger depressive Phasen und fühle mich insgesamt stabiler. Ich kann meine Gefühle besser zulassen und verstehe sie auch besser. Ich glaube, dass ich vorher sehr viel unterdrückt habe, vor allem Trauer und Wut, und dass mich das krank gemacht hat. Jetzt erlaube ich mir, traurig oder wütend zu sein, und es geht dann auch wieder vorbei. Das hat meine psychische Gesundheit sehr verbessert.

I'm more emotionally honest and that has helped my mental health. I have less of that underlying anxiety that comes from pretending all the time. I also feel more connected to people because I'm more real with them.
No real impact on my mental health, it was a fun night with friends.
Ich fühle mich in meiner Beziehung sicherer und geliebter, und das hat mir psychisch sehr geholfen. Ich bin weniger ängstlich und eifersüchtig.

My mental health is better than ever. I used to be quite depressed, especially in winter, and I had a lot of anxiety about my future. Since the experience I feel more grounded and more grateful for what I have. Even living with my parents again, which I hated at first, turned into something good. We grew closer, and I appreciate them so much more now. I'm also more open to unconventional paths, which is how I ended up starting my own business. I feel like I'm living my own life now and not the one I thought I should have.
First it made my mental health worse, I had panic attacks and felt very fragile. That lasted three or four months. Now I'm okay again and maybe a bit more aware of my own limits.
Ich fühle mich mit allem verbunden und weniger einsam. Das gibt mir viel Kraft und Liebe.
I'm less drained and exhausted, because I don't take on everyone else's emotions. My mood is better and I have more energy for myself and the things I love.

My anxiety has decreased a lot. I used to have a constant feeling of dread, especially in the mornings. Now I wake up and feel mostly okay, and when the anxious thoughts come, I can see them for what they are. I also feel more open, I'm less defensive and more willing to try new things.
Psychisch geht es mir besser, ich bin fröhlicher.
It didn't change anything for my mental health

My PTSD symptoms have gotten better. I have fewer intrusive images, I sleep better, and I'm not as irritable. But the biggest thing is that I feel more love and compassion, for myself and for others. I'd become really cynical and hard after years on the job, and the experience softened that. My wife says she has her husband back. I'm also more open to talking about mental health, which is still a bit of a taboo in my line of work. I've encouraged a few colleagues to get help.
Meine Stimmung ist stabiler, und ich habe weniger Ängste. Der Sport und die Meditation helfen mir sehr, dranzubleiben.
I feel more confident and more alive. I appreciate my life more since I almost felt I'd lost it during the trip.
I'm less anxious and more at peace. I also feel more open to life and to whatever comes. I don't need to control everything anymore, and that's made me a lot happier.
Ich bin weniger selbstkritisch und dadurch auch weniger oft niedergeschlagen. Ich verstehe besser, woher meine Zweifel kommen.
Mentally more stable and less exhausted, because I'm not overcommitting.
I think my general anxiety is lower, and I'm more grateful for every day. The accident could have been much worse.

Die Erfahrung hat meine psychische Gesundheit insgesamt sehr verbessert. Ich bin zuversichtlicher, mutiger und selbstbewusster geworden. Früher hatte ich oft Angst vor neuen Situationen und habe mich zurückgezogen. Heute gehe ich offener auf Menschen und neue Erfahrungen zu. Ich habe zum Beispiel angefangen, in einem Chor zu singen, was mir unglaublich viel Freude macht. Ich habe das Gefühl, dass ich mehr ich selbst bin als vorher.
I'm much less hard on myself and my mood is better. I don't fall into self-hatred spirals like I used to.
I'm less stressed and more balanced. I appreciate my friends more and I make time for them.
Hatte eigentlich keinen Einfluss auf meine Psyche.

I've struggled with binge eating and depression for over ten years. The experience didn't cure either, but it was a real turning point. For the first time, I understood why I eat the way I do, and that understanding has given me so much more compassion for myself. My depression has lifted quite a bit. I still have low days, but I'm not stuck in bed for weeks anymore. I've started to feel some love for my body, which I hated for so long. I'm also more open with my friends about what I'm going through, and they've been amazing. I feel less alone and less ashamed.
A little calmer but not a big difference
Ich bin optimistischer geworden und traue mir mehr zu. Meine depressive Grundstimmung hat sich deutlich gebessert, und ich habe mehr Freude an Herausforderungen.
Meh. I just don't really care much about things anymore
I feel more compassion and love for people, even difficult ones. That has made me happier and less resentful, which was eating me up before.
Ich bin gelassener und genieße mein Leben mehr. Ich mache mir weniger Druck und habe dadurch mehr Zeit für Dinge, die mir Spaß machen.
My anxiety is better. I'm also more curious about my own mind and how it works, I've been reading a lot about psychology.

My mental health has improved since I cut down on alcohol and weed. I'm less depressed and more clear-headed. I also understand myself better, I know now that I was self-medicating for anxiety, and I've started seeing a doctor about it.
Ich bin offener und weniger voreingenommen geworden, gegenüber anderen und gegenüber mir selbst. Das hat mir geholfen, mich besser anzunehmen, und ich fühle mich psychisch stabiler.
Less anxiety, more confidence, better sleep.

I feel a deep love for my wife that has carried me through her illness. My mental health has been surprisingly okay considering everything. I'm sad sometimes, but I'm also grateful for every day we have together. I appreciate the small moments, like when she laughs at a joke or when we watch the birds from the window. I think without the experience I would be much more bitter and depressed.
Kein Einfluss, soweit ich das sagen kann.
